name: HubSpot Deal Won → Xero Invoice (Starter Template)

nodes.name: HubSpot Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives deal stage change events from HubSpot. If on Starter plan, replace with a Schedule Trigger + HubSpot HTTP Request to poll deals API.

nodes.name: Filter: Won Deals Only
nodes.notes: Only proceed if the deal stage is 'closedwon'. Adjust the value if your HubSpot pipeline uses a different stage ID.

nodes.name: Map Pricing Tier
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Update the tierMap object with your actual 3 pricing tiers, descriptions, unit amounts, and Xero account codes.

nodes.name: Check: Valid Tier?
nodes.notes: Routes invalid pricing tiers to the error handler. Valid tiers continue to Xero contact lookup.

nodes.name: Xero: Find Contact
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set up Xero OAuth2 credentials. Searches for existing contact by email.

nodes.name: Xero: Create Contact
nodes.notes: Only runs if the contact doesn't exist in Xero. Creates a new contact from HubSpot data.

nodes.name: Xero: Create Invoice
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Build the invoice JSON body with the mapped line items, contact ID, due date, and tax settings.

nodes.name: Log to HubSpot
nodes.notes: Writes the invoice reference back to the HubSpot deal as a note. CONFIGURE: Add HubSpot API call to create an engagement/note on the deal.

meta.notes: Starter template for HubSpot Deal Won to Xero Invoice automation. CONFIGURE sections marked with 'CONFIGURE:' in each node's notes. This template covers the core flow; error handling and duplicate detection will be added during the build phase.
